text:
Zoe Park: Hi all — Zoe here, joining Platform (infra) from Barcelona. Hybrid remote — first day! Quick Q: I haven't received the Okta MDM invite and my laptop is asking for enrollment. Who should I ping?

Nina (People Ops): Welcome Zoe!! :tada: Tagging IT — @Marco can help with MDM and VPN certs. Also fill the shipping form if you haven't.

Marco (IT): Hi Zoe — sent Okta Device Management invite to zoe.park@redwood.ai. Check spam/promotions. If nothing, tell me laptop serial. After you accept run:
```bash
profiles status -type enrollment
```

Zoe Park: No email in spam. Serial is C02BZ12345.

Marco (IT): Thanks — pushed a manual token. You should get enrolled in ~2m.

devops-bot: Provisioning: created user zoe.park; added to teams: platform-engineering; channels: #platform,#new-hires.

Zoe Park: Enrolled and shows Compliant. Now trying to SSH but `Permission denied (publickey)`. I added my pubkey to onboarding-keys repo under my GitHub handle.

Luis (Platform): Welcome! Make sure file is named `zoe_park.pub` and contains a single key line. If so @ops-bot can sync.

ops-bot: SSH key sync triggered for zoe.park — complete.

Zoe Park: SSH works now, thanks! Last quick thing: where's the first-week checklist? Also fun fact: I bring my pet iguana to the office sometimes (he's shy). :lizard:

Nina (People Ops): Internal doc at https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/first-week. Welcome pack shipped (hoodie + stickers). Lunch crew in #random does a Barcelona meetup sometimes — will ping you.

Karen (Security): Welcome Zoe — reply to ops-ticket #4421 if you want a hardware 2FA key shipped.

Zoe Park: Awesome, thanks everyone. Looking forward to the buddy sync later! :sparkles:
